conflicts: nt_type: Salay 2021 (PMID:34610302) retrograde tracing finds all vLGN->Re neurons Vgat+ (238410529_b4b727f3), while Huang 2020 (PMID:33171117, 226284065_834809d9) labels Re-projecting vLGN/IGL cells as CaMKIIa neurons that activate Re neurons, and the Kerschensteiner review (PMID:35385673, 248001630_00a39dfb) describes them as giving a mixture of excitation and inhibition to Re. Unresolved whether the CaMKIIa (likely promoter-driven viral) population and the Vgat+ population are the same cells, or whether the CaMKIIa label is non-specific. Existing nt_type (GABAergic) and notes left unedited; the GABA call is now supported by direct tracing evidence (Vgat+), the REFUTE source remains.
Huang et al. cited in PMID:35385673 as 'Huang et al. 2021' is presumably the same study as PMID:33171117 (Huang 2020); year mismatch not resolved.
